decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The extension building hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 159, Brabazon Road.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the ____western________ wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The integral garage shown on drawing No. AP/BR/01A received 15.5.02 shall be provided before the extension to which it relates is occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles ancillary to the use of 159 Brabnazon Road as a single family dwelling house.
description: Erection of 2 storey side extension with garage, single storey rear extension and roof extension to existing dwellinghouse
